The comparators are the best-Crs and best-CL PEEPs (best_compliance_peep) and the EIT crossing point (other); the decremental PEEP trial is the shared measurement procedure for all five methods, including the Ptp ones, not a comparator.
EIT balance of overdistension and collapse has no specific comparator code, so 'other' is correct alongside best_compliance_peep.
A prospective observational study in which all five OPs were derived from one decremental PEEP trial in every patient; there was no allocation, so randomised is false by construction.
The flow chart lists balloon insertion as a protocol step for the 26 eligible patients but never states how many placements succeeded; 26 is an inference.
Patients were deeply sedated on cisatracurium, i.e. passive; the codebook codes the occlusion test in passive patients as dynamic_occlusion_test (Baydur is the spontaneous-effort version).
Balloon insertion is the first protocol step after eligibility (Figure 1); timing is known only relative to study entry, which the codebook codes as enrolment (timing_subgroup stays unclear).
26 eligible patients entered the protocol (balloon, EIT, RM); 5 were excluded afterwards for RM instability or incomplete EIT data, leaving 21 analysed. n_enrolled is 26; 21 is n_analysed.
The method is the lowest PEEP giving Ptp_ee_direct >= 0, which titrates end-expiratory Ptp to about zero rather than to a positive range.
